name: AniList Notifications Kolex06-Version
description: A Seanime sidebar panel for AniList notifications with larger cards and click-through detail popups.
author: Kolex06
notes: Requires an AniList account connected in Seanime. Open the AniList sidebar button, refresh notifications, click a notification for a larger popup, and use the AniList icon button to open the matching AniList page.

networkAccess.reasoning: Required to read the signed-in user's AniList notifications and display AniList cover/avatar images.

commandScopes.description: Open AniList notification, anime, manga, activity, thread, comment, and user pages in the default Windows browser.
